subject: Dispatch sidecar moves and shader variant lifetime must be snapshot-safe
body: Sidecar lifetime/variant wiring review before edit: draw_reorder.inc117..119 moves entire Dispatch structs by assignment. A heap-owned sidecar pointer moves safely, but sidecar.bindings must not point into its original Dispatch or a stack array. Prefer one owned allocation containing header+bindings; snapshot fail path render_encoder~2150, tegu_compositor_job_release~1528, and TeguCommand dealloc compute_frontend~1530 all need exactly-once free/reset. Current compositor_submit~224 reads pipeline->genericShader at EXECUTION, not a per-job shader snapshot. When runtime sampler specializations create different native programs, do not overwrite that mutable pipeline field: earlier queued draws would execute the newest shader. Retain the selected native-variant object/code/import handles per Dispatch (or immutable cache entries retained by job) and submit its exact shader+reflection. Cache eviction cannot release resources still referenced by queued jobs. Add one command containing nearest then linear then nearest with distinct specialization, release PSO/encoder before commit and exercise eviction; fake-kernel assertions must verify each selected code/reflection remains paired with its descriptor sidecar. This is owned-file implementation guidance, no new cross-owner grant or build.
